panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Islamic note: riba (رِبَا) is forbidden (Qur'an 2:275: Allah has permitted trade and forbidden riba). Islamic finance uses partnership (mushārakah, مُشَارَكَة) and cost-plus sale (murābaḥah, مُرَابَحَة) instead. Compound interest is examined in 4MA1 (1.6), so we learn the mathematics as knowledge of how the wider economy works, never as something to take.
